/**
   * Changes the read/unread status of all messages in the listed folders on the
   * Exchange server, if the server provides a dedicated operation to do this.
   *
   * If the server does not provide such an operation, the listener will use the
   * success callback with the use_legacy_fallback flag set, but the items will
   * not be marked read, and the consumer is then expected to use
   * `changeReadStatus` on the individual messages instead.
   *
   * @param folderIds - The IDs of the folders which read/unread status to
   *   change.
   * @param isRead - The new read/unread state for the messages, indicating
   *   whether the messages should be marked as read.
   * @param suppressReadReceipts - Whether read receipts should be suppressed
   *   for any messages marked read. This is ignored if the server is too old to
   *   support it (pre-2013).
   */
  void changeReadStatusAll(in IExchangeSimpleOperationListener listener,
                           in Array<AUTF8String> folderIds,
                           in boolean isRead,
                           in boolean suppressReadReceipts);
